title: Jadeite_Mod
description: Adds jade — a magical mineral used to create items with special functions.
body:
**Dirty Jade**: A raw mineral obtained by mining Jade Schist blocks found in caves or by brushing Suspicious Gravel in Trial Ruins.

**Jade**: Obtained by washing Dirty Jade in a Cauldron. This pristine gem can be placed, and the amount (1- 4) in a single block can be set by right-clicking.

**Jade Pieces**: A crushed form of the gem, obtained by jumping on placed Jade.

**Jade Dust**: A powder, crafted from Jade Pieces on a Crafting Table.

**Relic of murmurs**: A secret item — discover it yourself.

**Elder Guardian Eye**: Bonus item that drops with a small chance after defeating Elder Guardian

**Orchid**: An item obtained from the Wandering Trader. Place it on any type of log to grow more orchids.
You can also trade Orchids for Murmurmint with a Farmer Villager.

**Jadeite Bone Meal**: Created by combining Jade Dust with Bone Meal. Use it to enrich Farmland by right-clicking, which causes crops to grow at a significantly faster rate.

**Murmurmint**: Gives Invisibility when eaten.
